_doc: The board's columns, left to right. Edit freely: the board reloads this file on its next poll.
A row sits in the RIGHTMOST rule column whose `when` it meets, else in the `default` column.
when: label (name or list), claimed, pr, blocked, epic (true/false), any: [...], not: {...}.
label: dragging a card here sets this label and removes the other columns' labels.
pick: agents pick work from this column. limit: a WIP limit, shown on the column header.
plan: THE Up next column (the RESUME issue's order). closed: THE closed-lately column.
claim_label: the label an agent's claim puts on the issue (its release takes it off), so GitHub shows it too.
MIGRATION (decided 2026-10-23: keep the repo's old `In Progress` label until its sessions switch): the doing column also
matches `In Progress`. To finish: move each such card (`forge.py move <ref> doing`, which swaps the label), then
`gh label delete 'In Progress' -R <owner>/<repo>`, and drop `In Progress` from the doing column's `when`.

columns.name: Up next
columns.hint: What a bare /go picks, top first.

columns.name: Ready
columns.hint: Open, unclaimed, unblocked, no status. Highest severity first, then oldest.

columns.name: In progress
columns.label: status: in progress
columns.hint: An agent claims it, or someone is on it. (Also the older `In Progress` label, until it is renamed.)

columns.name: In review
columns.label: status: in review
columns.hint: Labelled in review, or an open PR names it.

columns.name: Blocked
columns.label: status: blocked
columns.hint: Waiting on a blocked-by edge, or on something outside GitHub.
